declarations.signature: struct Event<DonationInfo> where DonationInfo : Decodable, DonationInfo : Encodable, DonationInfo : Sendable
declarations.comment:
A repeatable user-defined action.

Use an event when you want to track an action that can occur one or more times in your app
(such as a user logging in).
Then use ``Tips/Event/donate()`` to donate to the event when the action occurs, increasing the
event count by one.

declarations.name: TipUICollectionReusableView
declarations.comment:
A UICollectionReusableView subclass that represents a tip.

You create a tip view by providing a tip and an optional arrow edge.
The tip is a type that conforms to the ``Tip`` protocol.
The arrow edge is a directional arrow pointing away from the tip.
